summary: "Micron Just Posted Insane Numbers. The Market Doesn't Care" by Couch Investor, published 2026-09-30, is a post-earnings breakdown of Micron's Sep 30 print: beats across the board — a record revenue ramp, $33.2B free cash flow, and 87% gross margin — but the stock didn't move; the only small miss was on the Q1 FY27 gross-margin guide. The video also touches on Anthropic ARR stalling and why market perception matters more than numbers in the short term. The digest records two calls: MU — HOLD (no change; he holds his own position with no plans to add) — he may reallocate to AVGO/NVDA if the 7.2x forward multiple stays "disrespected." AVGO — BUY restated (no flip; position initiated last week) — he still views it as undervalued, wants to grow the position, and cites AI revenue visibility doubling to $115B. No stance flips.
